title: The Measure tool stays in hand after a measurement lands, or hands back to Select
goal: Today every measurement you take hands the tool back to the arrow, so measuring several things means pressing I before each one. Decide whether the Measure tool should stay in your hand until you put it down, and build whichever the user picks.
notes: Found on the end-to-end walk (queue/audits/2026-09-02-redline-walk.json): four measurements cost seven presses of I. EditorState.addMeasure / addElementSize / addGapMeasure / addAlignmentCheck all call finishCreating(layer.id) which is setTool(.select). The arrow tool has precedent for staying in hand while a caption field is open (ArrowCaptionEntry.toolAfterLanding). If Measure stays, Esc and V put it down; the mode hint should not re-raise on every landing.
acceptance: A decision card offers the two behaviours with what the screen does after a click lands, and one is chosen
The chosen behaviour ships in Next behind next-measure-modes, Current unchanged
A second click after the first measurement behaves as the card promised, verified on the probe app

log.note: Waiting on the decision: stay in hand, hand back to Select, or stay for Size and Gap only
